name: Senden no Shugo Kishi Niina
original_name: 閃電の守護騎士ニィナ
source:
"God, protect me however you can---"

Somewhere in the spiritworld is a boiling bath of blood.
It's here that Gill, commander of beasts, and his dragon tribe recline in victory, having slain
Keshiel, the Knight Protector of Flame, and destroyed the thumb seal, one of 20 seals containing
the fingers and toes of the beast king Gill fights to free.

The reprieve from war is brief.
Gill's activities have flustered another spiritbeast army, and there is news
that they are about to attack the next seal ahead of him.
"Piddling whelps," the commander chuckled. "I'll show them how it's done!"
"What do you mean, sir......"
"Listen, my army! We go to battle! Now's your chance to raise the honor of the dragon tribe to new heights!"

The battlefield is Izunoe, the land that sealed the beast king's left middle finger.
It's protected by Guardian of Lightning Nina, blessed by the gods of thunder.

Nina fights to defend her honor, Gill to increase his own.
Good and evil are tossed about by the bloodlines of history, pulsing on a new battlefield. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE118202.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
“神啊，请尽你所能保护我——”

灵界某处有一池沸腾的血水。
兽族统帅吉尔与他的龙族在这里享受胜利，因为他们杀死了火焰守护骑士凯希尔，并摧毁了拇指封印。那是 20 个封印之一，封印着兽王吉尔试图解放的手指和脚趾。

战争带来的短暂喘息很快便结束了。
吉尔的行动惊动了另一支灵兽军队，消息传来，他们即将攻击前方的下一个封印。
“没用的小崽子。”统帅笑道，“我来教教他们该怎么做！”
“您这是什么意思……”
“听令，我的军队！我们出发战斗！现在正是让龙族荣誉更上一层楼的机会！”

战场是伊祖诺伊，那片封印着兽王左脚中趾的土地。
守护这里的是雷电守护者妮娜，她受到雷神的祝福。

妮娜为捍卫荣誉而战，吉尔则为提升自己的荣誉而战。
善与恶被历史的血脉抛向新的战场，在那里搏动。

[来自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE118202.html]DLsite English[/url]]
